name: dragons_lair_2
title: Dragon's Lair II: Time Warp (Digital Leisure, DVD)

notes.text: Power-on: title menu Play = b1; then 'Regular Moves' (b1) vs 'Slow Moves' (b2); then a black screen whose two hidden buttons both go on into the game (VTS 1 PGC 6). Route [1, 1, 1].
notes.why: The disc warns that some players cannot handle moves closer than 2 s and offers Slow Moves; Regular Moves is the timing stress test, so the scenarios play it.

play.description: Start a game and make every keyed move as its window arms: every move must land on a right option's next cell, with no death clip before the next move.

play_wrong.description: The control arm of 'play': the same run pressing a WRONG option at every keyed move (move_key pick='wrong'). moves_right must FAIL here, or it cannot tell a death from a survival.
